## High Visuals Configs

| Config | Description |
|---|---|
| HighVisual | High quality characters and textures, balanced performance |
| Z_Experimental | Alternative to HighVisual if you experience issues |

If HighVisual gives you trouble, try Z_Experimental instead.

Compilation of all performance configs compressed.

| Config | Description |
|---|---|
| Config_1 | High quality characters and textures, no shadows, no/minimal reflections |
| Config_2 | Minimal config (near-vanilla), high TAA |
